title: 数学、游戏，还有很多兴趣
Math, games, and many interests
body: 我学数学，喜欢玩游戏，也想自己做游戏。平时感兴趣的东西很多，文学、建筑、音乐、AI，都想多了解一点。
I study mathematics, love playing games, and want to make my own. I’m curious about a lot of things—literature, architecture, music and AI, to name a few.

title: 关于我

title: 不只玩，也想做
Playing—and making
body: 除了玩游戏，我也在做游戏。用 Godot 做过平台跳跃，用 Unity 写过敌人和 Boss 的行为。接下来还想继续做。
Besides playing games, I make them too. I’ve worked on a Godot platformer and written enemy and boss behavior in Unity. I want to keep making more.

title: 我的学习背景
My academic background
body: 我在武汉大学学习应用数学，接触了数学与统计相关的课程。这是我接触计算、AI 和游戏制作的知识基础。
I studied applied mathematics at Wuhan University, including mathematics and statistics. That foundation supports my exploration of computing, AI and game-making.

I studied applied mathematics at Wuhan University, including mathematics and statistics. That foundation supports my exploration of computing, AI and game-making.

title: 学校经历
My schools
body: 高中就读于上海交大附中。在武汉大学时，也参与过学生组织和志愿活动。现在在哥伦比亚大学学习运筹学。

I attended the High School Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University. At Wuhan University I also took part in student organizations and volunteering. I now study operations research at Columbia University.

title: 数学与建模
Mathematics & modeling
body: 我在武汉大学学应用数学。本科毕业论文做的是德国天然气网络流量预测，用时间序列模型来处理这个问题。
I studied applied mathematics at Wuhan University. For my undergraduate thesis, I used time-series models to forecast flows in the German natural-gas network.

title: 从数学到数据

I studied applied mathematics at Wuhan University. For my undergraduate thesis, I used time-series models to forecast flows in the German natural-gas network.

title: 做过的尝试
Things I’ve tried
body: 论文里，我比较了多种预测模型，做数据处理、训练和滚动评估。我也接触过优化建模和量子机器学习，研究过量子线路中的贫瘠高原问题。

For my thesis, I compared forecasting models and worked on data processing, training and rolling evaluation. I’ve also explored optimization and quantum machine learning, including barren plateaus in quantum circuits.

title: 用路径画 Kirby
Drawing Kirby with a route
body: 优化项目里，我做过资源分配和路径相关的问题，还用旅行商路径画过 Kirby。
My optimization projects have included resource allocation and routing. I also used a travelling-salesperson route to draw Kirby.

title: ToxBuster · 游戏聊天识别
ToxBuster · game chat detection
body: 我做过 ToxBuster 相关的复现和实验，识别游戏聊天中的有害语言。游戏里的聊天常常很短，也依赖上下文，不能只看某一个词。
I reproduced and ran experiments around ToxBuster to detect toxic language in game chat. Messages are often short and context-dependent, so a single word doesn’t always tell the whole story.

title: ToxBuster

I reproduced and ran experiments around ToxBuster to detect toxic language in game chat. Messages are often short and context-dependent, so a single word doesn’t always tell the whole story.

title: 我做了什么
What I worked on
body: 我在实验里关注聊天上下文对识别结果的影响，也比较模型的表现。这个项目主要做的是语言识别，不是游戏玩法。
In my experiments, I looked at how chat context affects detection and compared model performance. This project focused on language detection rather than gameplay.

title: RL · 宝可梦自动对战
RL · automated Pokémon battles
body: 我做过一个宝可梦自动对战的强化学习项目，让智能体在回合制对战里学习怎么决策。
I worked on a reinforcement-learning project for automated Pokémon battles, training an agent to make decisions in turn-based combat.

title: 让智能体学会对战

I worked on a reinforcement-learning project for automated Pokémon battles, training an agent to make decisions in turn-based combat.

title: 不同的决策方式
Different ways to make decisions
body: 我比较了 DQN、Double DQN 和 Dueling 等方法，观察它们面对不同对手时的表现，也研究了奖励设计会怎样影响它们的选择。
I compared methods including DQN, Double DQN and dueling architectures, looked at performance against different opponents, and studied how reward design affects their choices.

This is a retro Godot platformer I helped make. During the two-week team game jam, I contributed to level design, gameplay iteration and collaboration.

title: 敌人和 Boss
Enemies and bosses
body: 我写了敌人发现、追踪和攻击玩家的行为，也做了远程投射物、受击反馈和 Boss 的多种攻击。玩家移动、靠近或出招时，敌人都要有对应的反应。
I implemented enemy detection, pursuit and attacks, along with ranged projectiles, hit feedback and multiple boss attacks. Enemies need to respond when the player moves, approaches or attacks.

title: 想学太多，不知道从哪开始
Too much to learn—where do I start?
response: 我有点三分钟热度。刚开始自学 CS 和游戏开发时，看到什么都想学，但信息差很大，不知道从哪开始。收藏了很多教程，计划也排得很满，真正动手却没多少。后来我去找有经验的前辈聊，问他们怎么入门、哪些可以先放一放，再把目标缩小成眼前能做的一个功能。遇到不会的就查、就问，先把它做出来。我还是会分心，但比起重新列一份大计划，现在更愿意先做完手上的一点。

I tend to get excited about something and then lose steam. When I started teaching myself CS and game development, I wanted to learn everything, but I didn’t know where to begin or what I was missing. I saved lots of tutorials and made ambitious plans, yet did very little. Later, I talked with people who had more experience, asked how to get started and what could wait, and narrowed my goal to one small feature. When I got stuck, I looked things up or asked for help, then kept working until it worked. I still get distracted, but now I’d rather finish something small than write another huge plan.
